summary: Implemented the first static PlanIR execution service and scheduler slice without introducing a dynamic Planner path.

implemented_components.name: PlanExecutionService
implemented_components.reason: Owns PlanExecution and NodeRun CAS, lease, checkpoint, cancellation, retry, and terminal-state transitions.

implemented_components.name: StaticPlanScheduler
implemented_components.reason: Executes admitted immutable PlanIR as a finite DAG with bounded ready-node batches and explicit VerificationService boundaries.

implemented_components.name: PlanCheckpointRecord
implemented_components.reason: Captures recoverable plan and node status plus immutable budget snapshots and artifact/evidence references without storing secrets or transcript.

implemented_components.name: AwkpTaskProjection
implemented_components.reason: Projects PlanExecution state toward AWKP Task state without making PlanExecution the Task authority.

implemented_components.name: reconcile_plan_execution
implemented_components.reason: Detects orphan executions, expired leases, missing node evidence, terminal-goal mismatch, and inconsistent task projection.

state_authority.task_goal_authority: AWKP task.md/state.json and Goal/Claim records remain governance authority.
state_authority.plan_execution_authority: PlanExecutionRecord owns a single admitted PlanIR execution attempt.
state_authority.node_run_authority: NodeRunRecord owns one node attempt; retry creates a new NodeRun attempt.

scheduler_guards: Plan execution can start only with a passing PlanValidationReport whose subject digest matches PlanIR.digest().
PlanExecution and NodeRun writes require expected status_version CAS.
Lease writes carry holder and fencing_token; stale tokens and expired leases are rejected.
Ready nodes are derived from latest NodeRun attempts and satisfied dependencies.
PlanExecution and NodeRun records persist admitted PlanIR budget snapshots.
Node execution is bounded by the smaller of node.timeout_seconds and budget.maxWallSeconds.
deadline_at fails the PlanExecution before dispatching more nodes.
retry creates a new NodeRun attempt and does not repeat already succeeded dependency nodes.
cancel_execution moves every non-terminal active or pending NodeRun to canceled and leaves a handoff ref.
goal_verification nodes call VerificationService.complete; other declared gate boundaries call VerificationService.select.
non_goals_preserved: No dynamic Planner adapter was added.
No distributed queue or remote worker implementation was added.
Legacy standard-harness and loop-engineering paths were not removed.

acceptance_coverage.coverage: PlanAdmissionError rejects invalid reports and digest mismatches before PlanExecution creation.
StaticPlanScheduler derives ready nodes from dependencies, enforces max_concurrency, persists budget snapshots, bounds node wall-clock execution by budget.maxWallSeconds, and checks deadline_at.
Checkpoint records and latest-attempt lookup let a restarted scheduler skip succeeded idempotent nodes.
PlanExecutionService rejects stale expected_version and stale fencing_token writes.
cancel_execution cancels active and pending NodeRuns and records a terminal handoff reference.
AWKP Task projection is explicit and separate from PlanExecution and NodeRun records.
The static fixture path produces artifact/evidence/trace/handoff refs and passes the goal completion gate in tests.
